protocol.selection: first 8 entries in downloaded Karpathy validation annotation order; first caption per entry; no result-based selection
protocol.token_grad_activation: ReLU(sum_c grad(score, final_transformer_token[j,c])*token[j,c]), j>0; includes residual and MLP output before pooling
protocol.input_grad_activation: ReLU(sum over channels,pixels of input * grad(score,input) within each 16x16 patch); input normalized by model mean/std
protocol.input_abs_gradient: sum absolute input gradient over channels and pixels within each patch
protocol.candidate: previous saved multi-query spatial weighting; no formula changes

replacements.blur: torchvision Gaussian kernel51 sigma10 applied to normalized image; reflected padding

protocol.target: original OpenVision source-caption normalized cosine; raw trapezoidal AUC

limitations: 8 fixed convenience images; only source captions; 3 random seeds; raw scores and model-specific perturbations; descriptive diagnostic only
